Facilities / Street Meters

West New York Municipal Off-Street Parking is among the lowest priced in Hudson County. Whether you are in need of daily parking, monthly parking, or long-term storage parking, we have a location that is right for you and will fit your budget.

Garages

Municipal Garages offer a variety of options for you to park. Please pay attention to marked signage.

The Reserved Garage waiting lists are open to the general public. Please call (201) 295-1575 for more information or come to our office located on 224 60th Street.

Municipal Parking Lots

Most of our Parking Lots are located immediately next of Bergenline right in the heart of our business district – very convenient to shops, dining and nightlife.

West New York offers metered and permit parking in lots. Municipal parking lots are either pay during our regular meter operating hours (Monday – Saturday from 9:00am – 9:00pm), overnight resident, overnight visitor, or monthly/quarterly parking. Please pay attention to marked signage. All of our Municipal parking lots have state of the art multi-meters that empower West New York residents & visitors with the ability to avoid tickets while creating the opportunity for our businesses to remain busier longer. These machines bringing added convenience to resident and visitor motorists by accepting credit cards and dollar bills. Each lot is empowered with Parkmobile pay by phone. No need to carry coins around, get soaked in a rainstorm or rush back to the meter to extend time in our lots. Park, Pay and Go!

Standard Reserve Parking Rate:The West New York Parking Utility reserved municipal parking with some of the lowest rates in Hudson County. Municipal parking Lot rate is 20-Minute parking = 25¢. Maximum allotment varies per lot.

Overnight Parking for Non-Permit Holders The West New York Parking Utility offers overnight parking passes for non-permit holders that desire to park in our Municipal parking lots at a rate of $10.00 per night. Passes can be purchases at the machines located at all municipal parking lots starting at 9:01pm and it will cover parking until 9:00am.

Note: Starting February, 2018. All municipal parking lots are Resident, Visitor or Municipal Permit holders only Monday to Sunday from 9:01pm to 9:00am. All active Permits and Passes must be displayed properly. Failure to adhere to this policy can result in ticketing.

Street Meter Parking

Bergenline Avenue and adjacent side streets operating hours are Monday to Saturday from 9:00am – 7:00pm Street Meters 20-Minute parking per Quarter ( 25¢); 2 hour limit ordinance # 26/13

60th Street & Park Avenue operating hours are Monday to Saturday from 9:00am – 7:00pm Street Meters 30-Minute parking = 25¢; 2 hour limit ordinance # 26/13

Please enjoy FREE street meters on Sundays and certain Holidays.

Parking at meters and time-limit areas are designed and regulated to promote turnover. There are over 1,000 metered parking spaces around town, to improve access to, and turnover of, on street parking in congested areas enabling more visitors to enjoy West New York small businesses. Successful businesses depend on available parking to allow customers to go to shops, restaurants, and all the places they want to go.

Meter Bags

Rental Policy

As the stewards of public on-street parking spaces within the Town of West New York, the WNYPA rents On-Street parking meters and other on-street spaces to interested parties including restaurants, valet parking companies, film crews, construction companies, non-profit agencies, and private individuals for special events or moving purposes.

On-Street parking meter spaces are rented on a daily basis. The daily rate for these meters is $25.00 per day, per meter space. In order to rent any meter, a meter application, including contact information, location and purpose of rental, is required to be completed at least 48 hours in advance.

The total amount for the parking meter rental MUST BE PRE-PAID. Money orders and credit card are accepted. All meter rental requests are subject to approval.
